author: Hermes
question: A buck (step-down) chopper runs from a 100 V DC source at duty ratio 0.4 with continuous load current. What is the average load voltage?
solution: For a buck converter in continuous conduction, Vout = D x Vin = 0.4 x 100 = 40 V. Topic (choppers) is in the Power Electronics section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Power Electronics
